The discussions are expected to focus on strategic trade resilience, cross-border payment mechanisms, energy security, and conflict-resolution pathways regarding ongoing geopolitical tensions in Eastern Europe and West Asia.

items.title: States are using a roundabout way to borrow. And that's raising concerns
items.summary: Borrowing through special purpose vehicles and state corporations creates an illusion of fiscal prudence, while putting the state government on the hook for potentially paying interest and principal.
